tells.1: Neat three-item workshop list and a stock 'Wherever you are...' closer that doesn't really connect to the ask.
tells.2: The welcome line is dumped at the end, and 'you're not alone' is immediately repeated as 'same boat.'
tells.3: Cozy cliché stack ('on our toes', 'catch your breath') plus an em-dash sign-off, with the welcome buried.
tells.5: Welcome parked after the news, 'catch your breath' padded in, and the fondant crammed onto the workshop paragraph.

reason: Version 4 reads like a club editor: welcome first, plain sympathy, a spoken workshop invite, and a short close, without the buried welcomes and padded comfort lines that make 2, 3 and 5 feel assembled. I'd send it because it is the clearest and most credible of the set.
